# When will I get this Daily?

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 5, 2024
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1f88a87de3044ab39e83a0e0d4516a97~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Track current and upcoming Daily Quests.__

WIP - I'm still working out some bugs. If you find an error with the dates, please send me a message on here. Thank you!

Pip-Boy Daily Quests refresh at:

- 7:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (US EST) OR
- 8:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time (US EDT) during Daylight Savings

Completing Dailys rewards caps, scrip, XP, ammo, and offers a chance for rare plans and apparel to drop.

If you don't like the location a daily sends you to, you can server hop to change the location.

**Casual Underarmor Shielded Lining**

- Plan: Shielded Lining Casual Underarmor
- Drops from Daily: Queen of the Hunt

### **Apparel Drops by Region**

#### Forest Region Dailys (0.33% chance to drop)

- Forest Camo Jumpsuit
- Responder Fireman Uniform
- Responder Fireman Helmet

#### Savage Divide Dailys (0.15% chance to drop)

*Note: Dailys will only drop individual items, not multi-drop items.*

- Urban Scout Mask
- Forest Scout Mask
- BOS Jumpsuit
- White Powder Jumpsuit
- Whitespring Jumpsuit

#### The Mire Dailys (0.063% chance to drop)

- Tattered Field Jacket
- Leather Coat
- Traveling Leather Coat

#### Cranberry Bog Dailys

- Asylum Worker Uniform Brown (0.0067% chance to drop)
- Asylum Worker Uniform Green (0.0033% chance to drop)
- Asylum Worker Uniform Blue (0.0017% chance to drop)
- Asylum Worker Uniform Pink (0.00083% chance to drop)
- Asylum Worker Uniform Yellow (0.00042% chance to drop)
- Asylum Worker Uniform Forest (0.00038% chance to drop)
- Asylum Worker Uniform Red (0.000042% chance to drop)

**Biv's Daily Quest Condition:** Each day you visit Biv, there is a 50% chance to receive either "Tipsy Taste-Test" or "Wasted On." If you have completed all "Wasted On" recipes, you will only receive "Tipsy Taste-Test." Additionally, if you receive "Tipsy Taste-Test" two days in a row, you are guaranteed to receive "Wasted On" on the third day.

To use this calculator, enter today's date at the top and tick any relevant condition boxes as needed. The rest of the calculator will automatically populate.

The dates provided will only be accurate if you complete your dailies every day. If you skip any dailies, they will accumulate and remain active and open in your Pip-Boy under the daily tab. The Refuge Dailys are an exception to this rule.
